On 2026-08-24, FC Machida Zelvia officially announced the permanent transfer of Koki Ogawa from NEC Nijmegen. Historical overseas records remain preserved while future J1 collection stays out of scope.

On 2026-08-24, Schalke defeated Hallescher FC 5-2 after extra time in the DFB-Pokal first round. Satoshi Tanaka entered in the 105th minute. Schalke's official full match report covers the complete 15-minute appearance and confirms no Tanaka goal, assist, card, penalty-conceding event or own goal, allowing JFW Rating v1.0 = 6.00 at 0.447 coverage / medium confidence.

On 2026-08-25, Blackburn lost 1-2 to Sheffield United in the Carabao Cup second round. Ryoya Morishita started and was credited with the assist for Blackburn's goal; Yuki Ohashi also started and later left injured, with the exact substitution minute still unresolved in the retained record.

On 2026-08-25, Hull drew 1-1 at Stoke and advanced 5-4 on penalties. Sky Sports' complete teams list and commentary show that Hidemasa Morita was a substitute and entered in the 59th minute, correcting the prior record that had mistaken the substitution minute for 59 minutes played. Morita therefore played 31 minutes, recorded no goal, assist, shot or card, and created Cody Drameh's 87th-minute shot. JFW Rating v1.0 is 6.07 with coverage 0.563 and medium confidence.
On 2026-08-25, Birmingham lost 1-6 to Brentford. Tomoki Iwata entered in the 83rd minute; the retained player-stat fields confirm zero goals, assists, shots and shots on target for his appearance.

On 2026-08-25, Ipswich beat Leicester 3-1. Daizen Maeda was on the bench and entered late; required goal/assist/discipline fields are intentionally left missing pending a stronger exhaustive post-match source.
The Aug 26 Carabao playerMatchStats records have matching stable matchId entries in D.matches, preserving match provenance required by current-data-integrity checks.

On 2026-08-25, Leeds beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 in the Carabao Cup. Ao Tanaka started, was booked, registered one shot and one key pass, and was substituted in the 68th minute; JFW Rating v1.0 is 5.89 with coverage 0.563 and medium confidence.

On 2026-08-25, Coventry beat Plymouth 4-2 in the Carabao Cup. Tatsuhiro Sakamoto started and completed the match. Sky's complete commentary records one missed shot and one key pass, raising the verified JFW Rating v1.0 to 6.12 with coverage 0.764 and high confidence.

On 2026-08-25, Celtic lost 5-1 after extra time at LASK and exited the Champions League play-off 4-5 on aggregate. Reo Hatate entered in the 63rd minute and played 57 minutes through extra time. The complete event log records Hatate conceding the 113th-minute penalty, correcting penaltiesConceded from 0 to 1. JFW Rating v1.0 is therefore revised from 6.00 to 5.50 with coverage 0.447 and medium confidence.

On 2026-08-25, Valencia lost 0-1 to Real Betis in La Liga Matchday 1. Ryunosuke Sato started and completed the match, was booked in the 26th minute, recorded four shots including one on target, completed 18 of 20 passes, made one tackle and zero interceptions. La Liga's official event log credits Sato with the pass leading to Ugrinic's 90th-minute shot, so keyPasses=1 is selected over the conflicting secondary aggregate value of 0. JFW Rating v1.0 is 5.99 with coverage 0.791 and high confidence.

Keito Kumashiro was missing from the current tracked-player master. Eintracht Frankfurt officially signed him from Roasso Kumamoto effective 2026-01-01, and Bundesliga's 2026/27 official profile lists him as a Japanese Frankfurt striker wearing number 36 with zero league appearances to date.
